name: Blue Future Technologiegebiet / Eisenach-Stockhausen data center proposal
developer: FAB Unternehmensgruppe (area developer; investor/operator not named)
notes: City project page describes an 86 ha planned industrial/technology area between Stockhausen and Hoetzelsroda suited for a data center, with the official planning process not yet begun and city council approval required. Eisenach Online reported FAB's plan and up to 300 MVA grid connection availability; MVA is not converted to MW. MDR reported on 2026-07-02 that the Eisenach city council backed a residents' petition against the land-use plan and the mayor withdrew the next planning-step application, so status is marked rejected/vorerst gestoppt.

name: Bauhaus-Universitaet Weimar SCC / Konrad-Zuse-Medienhaus computing center
notes: Official university SCC page identifies the Servicezentrum fuer Computersysteme und -kommunikation as the university IT service center at Steubenstrasse 6a, 99423 Weimar, responsible for central campus IT services including virtual servers and hosting. Architecture sources document the conversion of the former Stadtbrauerei building into the university computing center and Faculty of Media, completed in 2002, with about 778.7 sqm identified as Rechenzentrum space; no MW capacity disclosed.

Targeted searches for Weimarer Land, Apolda, Bad Berka, datacenter/data center/Rechenzentrum, hosting, and hyperscale terms found no public datacenter project or facility in this district. Results were incidental references to external hosting providers, jobs outside the district, or unrelated uses of Rechenzentrum.
